rundown: Golden Knights beat Oilers 5-3 at Rogers Place in Edmonton in front of 18,347. It was level at 2-2 after two periods. The 1st period decided it: Golden Knights won it 2-0.
8 goals in all. Golden Knights's last: Trevor Connelly Goal Wrist Shot, assists: Mitch Marner (25), William Karlsson (6), 3rd period 17:28.
Leading the way — Golden Knights: Trevor Connelly 2 goals, 3 pts; Mitch Marner 2 ast. Oilers: Colton Dach 1 goal; Evan Bouchard 2 ast, 2 pts.
Where Golden Knights won it: they outshot them 27-23 and scored 1 on the power play to 0.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Golden Knights closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 0.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 8, over by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 7:58 PM ET. It had Golden Knights 47% and Oilers 53%, projecting Golden Knights 3.1 – Oilers 3.3 (6.3 total, Oilers by 0.2).

Final: Golden Knights 5 – Oilers 3. Wrong winner: it had Oilers at 53%, and Golden Knights (47%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Golden Knights came in with a 2% above average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (14-6-5, 3.4 scored and 3 allowed a game over 25 games), worth about 83 and 82 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.1, they scored 5 (+1.9 goals, 62% over); projected to allow 3.3, they allowed 3 (−0.3 goals, 8% under).

Oilers came in with a 7% above average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (17-5-4, 3.9 scored and 3 allowed a game over 26 games), worth about 83 and 83 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.3, they scored 3 (−0.3 goals, 8% under); projected to allow 3.1, they allowed 5 (+1.9 goals, 62% over).

The bigger miss was Golden Knights' scoring (+1.9 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 8 against 6.3 projected (+1.7), about the 75th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Golden Knights by 2 against Oilers by 0.2 projected, about the 19th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Oilers ×1.00, Golden Knights ×1.02. It favored Golden Knights, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
EDM ML (+100) at +100: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 48%). VGK ML (-120) at -120: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 52%). EDM +1.5 (-258) at -258: the algo gave it 70% vs 69% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. VGK -1.5 (+210) at +210: the algo gave it 30% vs 31% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+2.1u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 51% vs 52% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 49% vs 48% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 66% of bets on Golden Knights, 15% of the money — Golden Knights covered; total: 56% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 37% of bets on Golden Knights, 8% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Golden Knights, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.187 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -2.4 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 140 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.954 and gives home teams -0.2 goals. Team corrections so far: Golden Knights attack ×1.040, defense ×0.995 (9 games); Oilers attack ×0.982, defense ×0.960 (11 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
